title: com.steegler.matrixmedia.feed.post
$comment: Legacy name (ADR-0011). New name: dev.matrixmedia.feed.post (dev.matrixmedia.feed.post.json), same payload. Kept, frozen, as the schema the legacy wire-contract tests validate against; servers keep sending this name while the legacy contract is active and every reader keeps reading it.
description: Timeline event a client sends when a creator publishes a feed post. The server indexes it; it never sends it. Frozen legacy schema (ADR-0011): the payload the server sends today under the legacy name. The legacy wire-contract tests (crates/mm-api/tests/legacy_wire_contract.rs) validate real payloads against this file, so changing it changes what shipped apps are promised. The only allowed change is a new optional property that is omitted when empty.

msgtype.description: Fallback msgtype so non-MatrixMedia clients render the event as a notice.
